profile.Name: Rhinobot
profile.Personality: Callous and without feeling. He carried out the cruelest orders of the Second Empire without hesitation and shows no remorse.
profile.Backstory: He ran the child prisons of the Second Empire. Now he guards Ashland Dome II for Cat-Lon, armed with a fine katana.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Flat and mechanical; describes terrible things as routine.
